## Activity

During August 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 26 captures. This activity is reported for the site’s routine operations and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the completeness of the images received and the time taken for grading.

## Image quality

All 26 captures were available for grading. The number recorded as ungradable was 0, giving an ungradable rate of 0.0. This indicates that no captures in the August 2019 activity were excluded from grading because of image quality.

## Grading

There were 6 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 days. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the usual support process. This will help maintain consistent capture quality and support timely review of subsequent activity.
